name: Yodaka Ichizou
source:
"Am I a human, or am I Consuelo? I’m just as in the dark about myself as you..."

Former military and elite Blue Star pilot.
Menacing at first, but caring when least expected.
Second to none at engaging with vast sel energy.

Despite once leading his own elite pilot unit, he later deserted for reasons unknown. Now a fugitive escapee based in the Red Zone, he fights on to protect residents from Consuelo
with Sura, his "intergalactic pruning" Battle-SHEEP.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2051100]Steam[/url]]
